title: EvidenceUnitRef
description: A reference to an externally controlled unit of evidence. It is a REFERENCE, not a copy: the TIER-Graph layer MUST NOT require the full evidence content to be stored locally. The pair (`profileId`, `evidenceUnitId`) identifies the unit within a declared TemporalGroundingProfile, which is authoritative for resolving the unit to the source state that owns it. `evidenceUnitId` is an opaque identifier meaningful within the profile's substrate (e.g. a document-fragment id).

profileId.description: Identifier of the TemporalGroundingProfile that controls this evidence unit.

evidenceUnitId.description: Opaque identifier of the evidence unit within the profile's substrate.

selector.description: Optional selector refining the location within the evidence unit. A selector does NOT create a new source state.

locator.description: Optional dereferenceable URI for human access/provenance. Not used for logical inference.

displayCitation.description: Optional human-readable citation string for display.
